code.displayName: Other preparations (i.e., those preparations that do not fit another category)

text.paragraph: Acetaminophen 500 mg
Pain reliever/fever reducer

list.item:
temporarily relieves minor aches and pains due to:
the common cold
headache
backache
minor pain of arthritis
toothache
muscular aches
premenstrual and menstrual cramps
temporarily reduces fever

text.paragraph: This product contains acetaminophen. Severe liver damage may occur if you take

list.item: more than 4,000 mg of acetaminophen in 24 hours
with other drugs containing acetaminophen
3 or more alcoholic drinks every day while using this product

text.paragraph: Allergy alert: acetaminophen may cause severe skin reactions. Symptoms may include:

list.item: skin reddening
blisters
rash

text.paragraph: If a skin reaction occurs, stop use and seek medical help right away.

list.item: with any other drug containing acetaminophen (prescription or nonprescription). If you are not sure whether a drug contains acetaminophen, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
if you are allergic to acetaminophen or any of the inactive ingredients in this product

text.paragraph: Ask a doctor before use if you have liver disease
Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are taking the blood thinning drug warfarin

section.title: Stop use and ask a doctor if

list.item: pain gets worse or lasts more than 10 days
fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days
new symptoms occur
redness or swelling is present

text.paragraph: These could be signs of a serious condition.

code.displayName: OTC - PREGNANCY OR BREAST FEEDING SECTION

text.paragraph: If pregnant or breast-feeding, ask a health professional before use.

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

paragraph.content: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: In case of overdose, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. (1-800-222-1222) Quick medical attention is critical for adults as well as for children even if you do not notice any signs or symptoms.

item.content: do not take more than directed (see overdose warning)

tr.td: adults and children 12 years and over

list.item: take 2 caplets every 6 hours while symptoms last
do not take more than 6 caplets in 24 hours, unless directed by a doctor
do not use for more than 10 days unless directed by a doctor
store between 20-25°C (68-77°F)
do not use if pouch is torn or damaged

section.title: NEOSPORIN ® + PAIN RELIEF First Aid Antibiotic/Pain Relieving Cream

text.paragraph: first aid to help prevent infection and for the temporary relief of pain in minor:

list.item: cuts
scrapes
burns
if you are allergic to any of the ingredients
in the eyes
over large areas of the body

section.title: Ask a doctor before use if you have

list.item: deep or puncture wounds
animal bites
serious burns

section.title: Stop use and ask a doctor if

list.item: you need to use longer than 1 week
condition persists or gets worse
symptoms persist for more than 1 week, or clear up and occur again within a few days
rash or other allergic reaction develops

code.displayName: OTC - KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN SECTION

paragraph.content: Keep out of reach of children.

text.paragraph: If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Centre right away.

list.item:
adults and children 2 years of age and older:
clean the affected area
apply a small amount of this product (an amount equal to the surface area of the tip of a finger) on the area 1 to 3 times daily
may be covered with a sterile bandage
children under 2 years of age: ask a doctor
store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F)
